question: Where is the first tempered glass manufacturing plant in India located?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Noida, Uttar Pradesh.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The first tempered glass manufacturing plant in India has been inaugurated in Noida, Uttar Pradesh by Optiemus Infracom.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The plant, located in Noida, Uttar Pradesh, is part of India’s push for self-reliance in electronics manufacturing.**
 
• **It has a Phase 1 production capacity of 25 million units per year and is supported by an initial capital expenditure of ₹70 crore.**
 
• **In Phase 2, production will scale up to 200 million units per year, with an additional ₹800 crore investment.**
 
• **The facility aims to serve both domestic and global markets, positioning India as a global exporter in the electronics sector.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Optiemus Infracom__

 __
 
• An Indian electronics manufacturer focused on contributing to India's electronics manufacturing ecosystem.
 
 
 
• Tempered Glass Market__
 __
 
• The market is worth ₹20,000 crore annually in India, with a global market value exceeding USD 60 billion.
 
 
 
• Corning Technology__
 
 
• The plant is powered by Engineered by Corning™ technology, ensuring high-quality manufacturing standards.
